user_message: I don't know, I've tried everything, I think. I mean, I've always been a bit of a worrier, so I've tried deep breathing, progressive muscle relaxation, meditation... nothing seems to work for more than a few nights. And honestly, even when I do manage to fall asleep, I wake up in the middle of the night, my mind racing with all the things that could go wrong. It's like my brain just won't shut off. And now, with this fight with my partner, I just feel like I'm stuck in this never-ending cycle of anxiety and guilt. I keep replaying everything in my head, wondering what I could've done differently, if I'm even worth being with. It's like, what's the point of even trying if I'm just going to end up alone, you know?

user_message: I don't know, I just feel like I'm so broken, you know? Like, I'm not even sure why anyone would want to be with me in the first place. I mean, my partner is probably just humoring me, waiting for me to mess up again so they can leave me. And honestly, I don't blame them. I'm just so tired of being this way, of being a mess. I feel like I've been stuck in this rut for so long, and I don't know how to get out of it. Sometimes I just wish I could just disappear, just fade away, because it's all just so overwhelming. And at night, when I'm lying awake, it's like my mind is just racing with all the worst-case scenarios, and I'm just trapped in this never-ending cycle of anxiety and self-doubt.
